messages:
ana: Quick proposal - add an explicit ephemerality signal to error payloads and headers so SDKs and console can tell soft/transient vs sticky/terminal. Header+body+telemetry tag+sampling rules.

matt: +1. Minimal wire format?

sophie: Yes please. Current docs are fuzzy; a concrete header helps SDK retry semantics. :+1:

ana (ana): Minimal, backwards compatible: header x-rd-error-ephemerality: soft|sticky|terminal and optional body field error.ephemerality. Example:
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-rd-error-kind: route
x-rd-error-ephemerality: soft
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "error": {
    "code": "route_degraded",
    "message": "Serving capacity constrained, fallback applied",
    "ephemerality": "soft",
    "hint": {"retry_after_seconds": 2}
  }
}
```

ryan: Console mapping idea: soft -> amber 'degraded', sticky -> red 'restricted' with runbook, terminal -> red 'error' + alerting.

ana: Telemetry + sampling plan: tag error.ephemerality, error.kind, route.origin, tenant_quota_state. Sampling: soft -> 10% default, sticky/terminal -> 100%. Emit x-rd-sample-id uuid for sampled events.

infra-ops: For routing, if fallback used repeatedly >5s escalate soft->sticky and emit ephemerality_escalation event with previous/new.

ryan: SDK UX: soft -> gentle hint "transient capacity issue — retry with backoff"; sticky -> "routing degraded — consider pinning to dedicated tier or reduce concurrency"; terminal -> show error + runbook link.

sophie: Console UX: add a 'samples' tab keyed by x-rd-sample-id (PII scrubbed) to help triage.

ana: Rollout plan:
1) Runtime emit header & body behind flag route.add-ephemerality (staging).
2) Telemetry: add tags + sampled events.
3) SDKs: map headers to user hints (canary).
4) Console: badges + samples tab + runbook links.

matt: Backcompat: header-only additions are safe; body field optional. Add migration tests.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: route.add-ephemerality flag toggled in staging at 2026-03-20T10:05Z.

ryan: Action items: ana - write RFC with examples & metrics (due EOD Thursday). matt - SDK mapping PR. infra-ops - create escalation alert rule. sophie - console mockups. I'll coordinate rollout dates after RFC. :eyes:

ana: Will post RFC link in #eng-platform when ready.
